desc: The Tanfoglio Force Compact F is a compact semi automatic pistol that brings a lot of power to the table. The pistol comes with a 3.7" barrel give a shorter front profile without sacrificing all of the rounds velocity. The grips is shortened form the standard model for a more compact overall profile. The pistol is kept at a lighter weight with the use of a polymer frame that is textured to help you maintain a firm grip on the firearm despite the weather conditions. The pistol comes with a manual safety and a double action shooting mechanism so you giving you multiple layers of safety.
